characters.name: 有间太一郎
characters.description: 有间太一郎在虚拟世界Planet中使用“Ichi”作为游戏名，是高阶公会赤羽家族的核心成员。他战斗能力极强，却性格急躁、爱计较，尤其在别人不认真听他的招式名称或取笑他时容易发火。太一郎在游戏中能冷酷击杀其他玩家，现实生活里则是一个与家人疏离的少年；他与赤羽士郎之间的父子关系逐渐成为故事核心。

source.description:
Member of the high-level Akabane Family. Although insanely strong, he's very petty and short-tempered, especially if people don't take his flashy technique names seriously or make fun of him. He also doesn't seem to mind killing other players at any given time - something which the Planet community strongly frowns upon.

~!In the real world, he's a shut-in, living on terrible terms with his family - especially his father, whom he considers loathsome and irredeemable, and his brother, whom he assumes must be looking down on him all the time. However, he's a very skilled programmer, for example being able to create a program to bypass a ban with minimal effort.!~

~!He hates when Aya is brought up in conversation, prompting him to have PTSD flashbacks and snap at whoever brings her up.!~

characters.name: 赤羽士郎
characters.description: 赤羽士郎是Planet中高阶公会赤羽家族的成员，可靠、睿智且实力强大，被公会视为不可缺少的支柱，Ichi也把他当作父亲般的人物。士郎在游戏中承担团队稳定者角色，现实身份则是有间家父亲有间浩次郎。游戏中的理想化形象与现实家庭中的沉默和失意形成反差，逐步揭示他与太一郎及其他家人之间的真实关系。

source.description:
One of the members of the high-ranking Akabane Family. Due to being dependable, wise and strong, Ichi looks up to him as a sort of father figure, and the rest of the guild sees him as their backbone.

~!He's actually Ichi's real-life father, as well as the creator of Planet. Although he's an extremely skilled programmer and tech genius, he's also a hopeless perfectionist who dislikes anything illogical, which often had terrible consequences for his children - most notably Aya, who was often the target of his scrutiny due to her timid nature.!~

~!He blames himself for his daughter's death, having even gone as far as creating an AI replica of her in an attempt to bring her back and apologize for his mistakes.!~

characters.name: 有间明
characters.description: 有间明在Planet中使用“AAAAA”作为游戏名，是赤羽家族成员。他性格友好开朗，战斗能力不及公会里的高手，也坦言自己不擅长想名字，因此取了重复字母作为游戏昵称。明在现实生活中是有间家的次子，和哥哥太一郎、父亲浩次郎同住一个家庭，却同样在家中感到疏离；网络公会成为他寻找亲密关系的地方。

source.description:
One of the Akabane Family's members. He's very friendly and cheerful, although not as skilled as the rest of the guild's members. He also remarks that he's not a very creative person, which is why he named himself the way he did.

~!In real life, he's actually Ichi's younger brother and seems to have a successful professional career. However, he struggles to express emotions, which makes him often come off as cold and uncaring.!~

characters.name: 有间小夜
characters.description: 有间小夜在Planet中使用“May”作为游戏名，是赤羽家族成员。她不擅长正面战斗，却是一名优秀治疗者，也因温柔善良成为公会成员的情感支柱。小夜偏爱游戏里的和平活动，例如照料宠物和体验日常内容。她在现实中是有间家的母亲，游戏中的温暖形象与家庭成员之间的冷漠距离构成鲜明对照。

source.description:
One of the Akabane Family's members. Although she's not very good in combat, she's an excellent healer, as well as the emotional backbone of the group due to her kindness. She enjoys peaceful side content in the game a fair bit, such as taking care of the flower garden or cooking for the other three guild members, even though she knows it's only a game.

~!She's actually the wife of Shiro/Kojirou in real life, as well as the mother of Ichi and his siblings. Following the death of Aya, she would move out into a net cafe, where she's lived ever since. Her mental health seems to be in a very poor state - although she still cares for her sons and husband when she decides to visit their house, she seems to be largely just going through the motions without thinking much of her actions, repeating the same phrases repeatedly and often smiling in moments that don't require her to.!~

characters.name: 叉叉
characters.description: 叉叉是Planet中的人工智能角色，也是商会领袖莱昂最好的朋友。它性格幼稚、爱演戏，经常在莱昂被砍下头后把他的头抱着走。叉叉并非普通玩家，而是Planet代码中的AI之一，其存在与士郎对游戏程序的研究有关。它的滑稽行为为虚拟世界增加喜剧色彩，也逐渐让故事触及游戏角色是否拥有自我意识的问题。

source.description:
Leon's best friend, a childish sidekick who often engages in wacky theatrics and carries his head around whenever it gets cut off.

~!Their real identity is an AI, being one of many living within Planet's code as a result of Shiro/Kojirou attempting to bring back his dead daughter. However, Sasumata is the only one aware of their true nature as such, which makes them question the nature of their existence and purpose in life constantly.!~

characters.name: 茂毒
characters.description: 茂毒是Planet海盗公会头目皮可的部下，也是她严肃而令人生畏的右手。他表面上协助公会活动，真实目的却与皮可不同；茂毒并不关心Planet或玩家，把周围人视作达成个人目标的工具。他的冷酷立场与游戏世界中其他享受冒险的玩家形成反差，也让虚拟世界的冲突逐渐连接到程序和现实中的阴谋。

source.description:
One of Pico's subordinates, her serious and intimidating right-hand man.

~!He actually never truly cared about Planet and deeply loathes every player around him, seeing everybody, including Pico, as mere means to an end, his only true desire being to get his hands on the prize money offered for capturing the Black Bird.!~

~!In real life, he seems to be a failed musician, living in a rented apartment, which he struggles to pay rent for in time.!~

~!Following his encounter with the Black Bird, he becomes stuck in an endless simulation, dying over and over again.!~

characters.name: 皮可
characters.description: 皮可是Planet中海盗公会的船长，性格傲慢任性，习惯依照自己的兴趣做事，把好玩放在第一位。她常带领公会成员在游戏中捣乱，给其他玩家制造麻烦；海盗团伙伴也大多有相似的恶作剧风格。皮可与副手茂毒共同管理公会，却没有意识到茂毒并不认同她对游戏的热情。

source.description:
Captain of the pirate guild in Planet. A very arrogant girl who enjoys acting on her whims and prioritizes having fun above all else, often griefing and generally being a nuisance in-game, with her crew consisting of likeminded people who play the game to mess with others. At times, she tends to casually make wordplays that integrate her name into random words.

Her only weakness seems to be a hopeless infatuation with Ichi, as the two had bonded over their loneliness in the past and, impressed with his chuunibyou antics, she considered him the coolest player on Planet. She tends to daydream about what could happen if they met in real life, thinking she would be able to help Ichi recover from his life as a shut-in and even fix him in general.

~!She was one of the AIs made by Kojirou in an attempt to bring back his daughter, and arguably one of the more elaborate ones, being able to swap out at will between Planet and a simulation of the real world, as if she were truly an ordinary human playing a videogame. Her mind is a perfect replica of a deceased girl by the name of Hanako.!~

characters.name: 莱昂
characters.description: 莱昂是Planet贸易公会的负责人，常宣称自己保持中立，却认为真正热爱游戏的玩家有责任守护Planet。他关注虚拟世界的秩序与玩家行为，也会参与公会间的交涉和冲突。莱昂与人工智能角色叉叉关系亲密，后者经常陪伴他行动。随着游戏世界出现异常，他开始面对玩家是否应当保护虚拟居民的问题。

source.description:
Head of a trading guild in Planet. Although he tries to stay neutral and maintains that he is, he considers himself to be part of a very small group of Planet players that genuinely love the game, strongly believing that they are morally obliged to backseat moderate, sabotage and eliminate those who, in their view, spoil others' fun, such as Pico's pirates.

~!In real life, he's a young schoolkid who never had friends before meeting Sasumata, which made him want to create a world where AIs get what they want, believing that they are alike.!~

characters.name: 神室花
characters.description: 神室花是有间浩次郎的得力助手，工作时冷静沉着，把上司视作无可置疑的天才。她对浩次郎抱有强烈而单方面的爱慕，常主动表达亲密意愿，令浩次郎感到为难。花参与现实中的工作和程序研究，也逐渐接触有间家庭与Planet之间的秘密。她的感情执着与专业能力并存，是现实线的重要人物。

source.description:
Kojirou's daughter and the youngest of the three siblings. Although she was a very sweet child who cared a lot about others, she was often the target of her father's wrath, as he considered her to be the most clumsy and irrational.

~!After her father forced her to go back to school late at night to pick up a notebook that she forgot to take home, she would fall victim to a serial killer, prompting the family to break apart and traumatize her oldest brother.!~

characters.name: 绪方修
characters.description: 绪方修身高约179厘米，经营一家小型私人军事公司，平时却因不擅理财而常常负债。他是孤儿，家人在故事开始前的一场恶魔灾害中遇害，修因此持续追查真相并试图复仇。为了获得战斗力量，他与恶魔少女基萨拉建立契约，代价是逐渐失去关于过去的重要记忆。修在金钱、记忆与复仇之间不断付出代价。
